description: Full-text search across every project card and the entire journal, archived months included. Returns each matching line with its location. START HERE whenever you know a keyword, a task id or a name but not which project owns it — searching once beats guessing project × status against hub_task_list, which is how sessions have actually wasted calls. Also the way to find where something was discussed or decided.

full.description: return everything, uncapped. By default long lists are trimmed (and, where the description says so, long texts cut) to fit an agent context, and what was left out is reported in `truncated`.

name: hub_search
